title: Marketing, referrals and retention for pool service work
audience: Owners and office staff who plan how a pool service finds, keeps and refers customers
learningOutcomes: Choose marketing channels for each customer segment and state the reason for each
Set up a referral route with property managers, real estate agents, builders and other trades
Plan retention activities such as service follow-up and annual service agreements
Check every marketing claim against the evidence and the advertising rules before it is published

instruction.heading: Channels that match the customer
instruction.body: A pool service reaches home owners, body corporates, commercial operators and property managers through different channels. The sample plan lists social media, content marketing, an email newsletter, paid search, brochures, referral programmes, direct sales calls and partnerships. Those are a useful list of channels. Choose the channels that reach the segments in your own analysis, and state the reason for each one. Record how many enquiries each channel brings, so that the channels that do not work can be dropped.

instruction.heading: Referral and partner routes
instruction.body: The most reliable source of pool work is often a referral from someone who already trusts the service. Property managers, real estate agents, builders, pool installers and other trades can refer clients. Set up each partner route in writing. State what the partner gets, what the business gets, and how referrals are logged.

instruction.heading: Claims and advertising
instruction.body: Every marketing claim needs evidence. Words such as safe, chemical-free, eco-friendly, guaranteed, certified or the best must be avoided unless the business can show the evidence and the claim is accurate. Testimonials must be genuine, given with permission, and not invented. Check each claim, and each advertising channel, before publication.

instruction.heading: Keeping customers
instruction.body: Retention is cheaper than acquisition. Build routines that keep customers informed: a short note after each visit with the readings and the tasks done, a reminder before a seasonal task, and an offer of an annual service agreement with its terms written out. Follow up on any complaint and record the outcome. A loyalty discount is a pricing decision and follows the rules in “Pricing pool visits and service packages”.

instruction.heading: Tracking what works
instruction.body: Track the enquiries, the conversions, the cost of each channel and the retention rate by segment. Review the tracking at a set date. Stop or change any channel that costs more than it returns.

procedure: List the segments and the decision-maker for each.
Choose the channels for each segment and record the reason.
Set up each referral route in writing, with the terms and the logging method.
Check each marketing claim against evidence and the advertising rules, and leave out any claim that is not checked.
Plan the retention routine, including the post-visit note and the annual agreement terms.
Set a date to review the tracked channels and their cost.

workedExamples.situation: The owner wants an advertisement that says the pool service is chemical-free and eco-friendly.
workedExamples.reasoning: Do not publish the claim until the business can show evidence for it, and the wording is checked against the advertising rules. Replace it with a claim the business can support, such as a description of its products and methods with a source for each.

workedExamples.situation: A property manager offers to refer their rental properties if the pool service pays a fee for each referral.
workedExamples.reasoning: Do not agree to the payment until the arrangement has been checked against the Australian rules. Record the offer and the check. Set out the referral route in writing once it is confirmed.

equipmentAndPpe: Channel plan with reasons and the enquiry log
Customer register with consent for testimonials

commonErrors.error: Publishing a claim the business cannot evidence
commonErrors.prevention: Check each claim against evidence and the advertising rules before it is published.
Use only genuine testimonials given with permission.

commonErrors.error: Paying a referral fee without checking the rules
commonErrors.prevention: Check the arrangement before it is offered.

commonErrors.error: Keeping channels that cost more than they return
commonErrors.prevention: Track each channel and review at a set date.

safetyAndRegulatory.point: Each claim and each arrangement must be checked before use.
A marketing claim that a service is safe or that a barrier is compliant must not be made. Compliance and safety are decided by the authority and the operator.
Customer details used in marketing must be handled in line with privacy rules.

qualityStandard: Each channel has a segment and a reason.
Each claim is evidenced or removed.
Each referral route is in writing and its legal status is checked.
summary: Choose channels for each segment and track what each one returns.
Evidence every claim, and check the advertising rules before publishing.
Keep customers with clear routines and written terms.

knowledgeChecks.question: A marketing draft says the service is chemical-free. What should happen before it is published?
options: Check the claim against evidence and the advertising rules, which have not yet been confirmed
Remove the word and publish the rest of the draft unchanged in the paper, online and on the van
Ask a friend whether it sounds right to them first before the post goes live
Publish it, since it is a common phrase used in the trade by many businesses

knowledgeChecks.question: What should a referral arrangement with a property manager have in writing?
options: Nothing, since it is informal and friendly with the agent and the office at the site and the owner
The terms, what each party gets, and how referrals are logged, with any payment checked first
Only the fee, with no other terms or conditions set out in writing at all or in the file
The client's private contact details and their home address and the keys code

knowledgeChecks.question: What is the purpose of tracking enquiries by channel?
options: To avoid reviewing the business plan at the end of the year and the quarter
To decide which staff member is most popular with clients in the area and town
To find which channels bring work at an acceptable cost, and to stop the others
To set the chemical prices for the season, the products, the stock and the supplier
